description: Header file defining the StableLibrary class and related macros for registering and managing stable Torch libraries and their implementations, including template utilities for argument boxing/unboxing.

classes.name: StableLibrary
classes.description: Manages registration and lifecycle of stable Torch libraries, including initialization, implementation, and def registration.

classes.name: StableTorchLibraryInit
classes.description: Initializes a StableLibrary and executes a user-provided function for setup.

classes.name: UnboxType
classes.description: Template struct for mapping types to their unboxed equivalents.

methods.name: impl
methods.description: Registers a function implementation with the library.

methods.name: def
methods.description: Registers a schema definition with the library.

methods.name: StableTorchLibraryInit
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a StableLibrary and runs a setup function.

methods.name: unbox_to_tuple
methods.description: Converts a stack of StableIValues to a tuple of arguments.

methods.name: box_from_tuple
methods.description: Boxes a tuple of values into a stack of StableIValues.

methods.name: boxed_fn
methods.description: Generated function that boxes a C++ function for use with StableIValue stacks.
